days.theme: Cruise in, land softly on the riverfront
days.why: The morning is not yours: 07:00 at Zhujiang Wharf, ~09:20 sailing, ~4h15 of karst, dock Yangshuo 13:30 and clear by 13:45. That leaves one usable half-day, and it has to be spent within walking distance of the hotel. West Street (90 min) plus the lit waterfront after dinner (45 min) is exactly that — both sit on the same riverfront block, so the afternoon and the after-dark versions of the same walk cost nothing in transfers. Critically, this evening is kept SHORT and ends by ~20:30: the dawn run to Xianggong is tomorrow at 04:15, and day 1 already began at ~05:30 in Guilin. The Impression Liu Sanjie show was deliberately moved off day 1 for that reason — a 21:00 curtain followed by a 04:15 alarm is the one combination that wrecks both. NOTE: the first half of this day happens in GUILIN — you wake there and the 07:00 Zhujiang Wharf call is the Guilin end of the ferry. It renders under Yangshuo because Notion dates 30 August to Yangshuo. Dinner had been missing entirely from this day: the chain treated the departure hub as the thing that closes a day, which is true everywhere except a transit day, where the hub sits at 07:00 — so every meal after it was discarded and you docked at 13:30 into an evening with no dinner. Fixed; dinner now 18:46. Still open: there is no Breakfast stop in the source data for this date, against a 07:00 wharf call — either add one in Notion or plan on the boat, and check whether your cruise ticket already includes the lunch, since the 13:53 lunch here may double up with it. The Li River night walk was scheduled 17:53, in daylight against a ~19:00 sunset, on a stop that exists only for the illuminated riverfront. Dinner is held to 17:00 so it lands straight off West Street and the walk falls after dark at 19:31. Dinner has to open BEFORE West Street ends at 17:27 or it fires after the walk instead and pushes the day to 21:38.

days.theme: Dawn at Xianggong and the Xingping bend, then the show
days.why: Dawn at Xianggong, the Xingping bend, then the show — the classic hot-climate shape: up at 04:15 for the 05:00 gates, the whole northern cluster done by 09:54, back in town about 10:25, lunch at 12:15, then a genuine siesta through the worst heat, out again for the 19:45 curtain. The afternoon is empty because the Xingping cluster contains exactly three things and every other Yangshuo sight is already scheduled — but it is now rest WITH a purpose at the end of it rather than an unexplained void. Impression Liu Sanjie belongs on this day and not day 3: it is a town evening activity, so it crosses no cluster, and putting it here is what stops day 3 running to 21:24 after a full day on the water and the bike.

Yulong valley, whole and uninterrupted: raft the Jinlong-to-Jiuxian section from 09:30 (the operator hint, which is also what closes the two-hour hole an 08:00 raft would leave), cycle the Shili Gallery loop, lunch off the bike, then Moon Hill in the late afternoon when the 800 steps are out of the worst sun. Breakfast at 08:00 rather than 07:00 because nothing opens before the rafts do. No show on this day and no evening commitment — home 19:46, which is what makes a five-and-a-half-hour outdoor day survivable in early September heat.

HO1148 needs you AT Guilin Liangjiang by 08:20 and KWL is 65-80 min from Yangshuo, so the car leaves ~06:40 and the alarm is ~05:45. There is time for breakfast and nothing else. Nothing was placed here, and day 3's evening was kept free precisely so this morning is only tired, not brutal. Breakfast to 05:30. HO1148 is BOOKED and it is the leg that connects to Shanghai, so the 08:20 call is not negotiable; the run to KWL is modelled at 107 min for 67 km, which is conservative. That leaves about 20 min of margin on top of the 120-minute buffer already inside the call time.

ideas.name: Sunrise balloon flight
ideas.why: The best thing here that does not fit. It is a second dawn (04:00-06:00 pickup) in a stay with room for exactly one, and it collides head-on with Xianggong — same hour, same light, same karst. At ~USD 260-300 pp it is flagged as a big-budget swap, so treat it that way: fly it INSTEAD of Xianggong on day 2 morning if the spend appeals and the forecast is clear, rather than as an addition. Note the current plan had it at 21:20, which is not a thing — balloons only fly at dawn. Weather-dependent either way, and a scrub with no backup dawn left is the real risk.

ideas.name: Fengqi Homestay
ideas.why: Not a sight — this is the lodging itself (3 nights, check-in on arrival ~14:15 after clearing the wharf at 13:45). Deliberately kept out of the day plans so it does not consume a stop slot; it is simply where each day starts and ends.

notes: MUST: Li River cruise (it is the transit itself), Xianggong sunrise, Yulong bamboo rafting, Yulong valley cycling, Impression Liu Sanjie, 20-RMB viewpoint.
WORTH: Xingping Ancient Town (only because you are already there for Xianggong — not worth a dedicated 40 min run each way), West Street, Moon Hill, Li River night walk.
DROP / SWAP-ONLY: Sunrise balloon flight — a duplicate dawn at ~USD 260-300 pp; take it only as a straight substitute for Xianggong.

Corrected error: the old plan had Sunrise balloon flight at 21:20 and both dawn activities on the same day. Balloons and Xianggong are ~05:00 activities; only one dawn fits in three nights, and it costs the afternoon that follows.
Show time confirmed: Impression Liu Sanjie runs 19:45, with a 21:20 second performance added when demand is high; ~70 min. Booked in advance. Take the 19:45 — the 21:20 pushes bedtime past 23:00.

Xianggong confirmed: gates 05:00 May-Oct, steep ~20 min climb with handrails, be at the summit by ~05:30 for a rail spot. Sunrise Yangshuo early September ~06:20. Pre-book the car the night before; DiDi at 04:30 is not reliable.

Geography: three clusters. Yangshuo town (West Street, night walk, hotel, show site ~10 min out) / Yulong valley to the west and south (rafting, cycling, Moon Hill) / Xingping to the north ~40 min (Xianggong, Xingping town, 20-RMB viewpoint). Day 2 and day 3 each take one outlying cluster whole; nothing crosses between them.

Load: day 1 ~2h15 of afternoon stops after a locked morning, day 2 ~4h30 (dawn day, rest block 12:00-17:30), day 3 ~5h30 of stops / ~9h out. Day 2 is under the 8-10 h target on purpose — a 04:15 start spends the afternoon.
Bookings needed: Li River cruise (4-star, ¥360-480 incl. lunch), Impression Liu Sanjie, Xianggong entry + pre-dawn car, Yulong raft (¥150-200/raft). Bikes can be walked up to on the day.

Weather hedge: rafting and cycling are both on day 3 and both wash out together. If day 3 forecasts rain, swap day 2 and day 3 wholesale — Xingping works damp, and the show is under open sky but runs in light rain. The dawn is the piece that cannot be moved late, so it must lead whichever day it lands on.
The Yangshuo wharf pin is hand-placed ~200 m off (阳朔码头 does not geocode); day 1's 13:45 clearance is treated as approximate and nothing is scheduled tight against it.
